purpose: Bound the minimum upstream JAP job projection and deterministic export format needed by the existing JAP Cloud JobRepository contract before any source-data extraction or Azure import.

key_relationships.migration_scope_usage: provenance_only; raw_jobs is not selected or exported

mapping.job_id: trim(source_name) + ':' + trim(external_job_id) when external_job_id is non-empty after trimming, otherwise trim(source_name) + ':raw-' + raw_job_id
mapping.title: trim(title)
mapping.posted_at: publication_date rendered as ISO-8601 calendar date without inventing time-of-day precision

eligibility.scope_rule: Export only rows that can truthfully populate the existing Job domain contract. Do not fabricate missing presentation fields.

selected_source_rows.rule: Must be positive after the manifest-bound eligibility filter; the exact value is measured only during an authorized live extraction.

export_rows.rule: Must equal selected_source_rows after all pre-import invariants pass; otherwise export fails closed rather than silently dropping rows.

target_import_rows.rule: Must equal export_rows after an authorized target import; this provider-free preparation does not assert a target count.

rejected_rows.rule: A successful path has zero silently rejected rows; any row-level invariant failure blocks progression and is evidence, not an implicit filter.

export_contract.input_shape: JSON array whose row objects contain exactly the selected source columns and no additional source fields
export_contract.text_normalization: Strip surrounding Unicode whitespace from selected text fields; reject values empty after trimming; perform no other text transformation.
export_contract.sort_semantics: publication_date as ISO date descending; source_name Unicode code-point ascending; non-null external_job_id Unicode code-point ascending before null; raw_job_id integer ascending

pre_import_invariants: Every exported job_id is non-empty and unique within the export.
Every exported title, employer and location is non-empty after trimming.
Every source_url is an absolute http or https URL.
Every posted_at value is derived only from publication_date and preserves its date precision.
Every exported row is traceable to source_name plus external_job_id or raw_job_id.
Every input row contains exactly the selected source columns, so the export contains no raw_data payload and no applicant/application data.
